en_title: Star Wars Nabs Spider-Man Director Jon Watts for First Movie in Disney's New Skywalker Saga Trilogy
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠》据称《星球大战》新片选定导演
subtitle: 天行者传奇再续
opus_summary: 据报道，迪士尼选中Jon Watts执导《星球大战》新三部曲首作，延续天行者传奇。Simon Kinberg负责编剧，蕾伊据称将登场，项目尚未正式获批。

paragraphs.en: Disney has reportedly picked Spider-Man alum Jon Watts to direct the first movie in a new Star Wars trilogy that will serve as the next chapter of the Skywalker Saga.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，迪士尼已选中执导过《蜘蛛侠》电影的Jon Watts，担任《星球大战》新三部曲首部电影的导演。这套三部曲将开启天行者传奇的新篇章。

paragraphs.en: Information about a new series of Star Wars projects from Lucasfilm was first reported by Daniel Richtman and later corroborated by The Hollywood Reporter . Although Watts is best known for leading the charge on the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Tom Holland Spider-Man trilogy, his work on Star Wars would represent his return to the sci-fi franchise following his time as co-creator on 2024's Skeleton Crew .
paragraphs.cn: Daniel Richtman最先报道了卢卡斯影业这批《星球大战》新项目的消息，随后好莱坞报道者也证实了该消息。Watts最为人熟知的作品，是漫威电影宇宙中由汤姆·赫兰德主演的《蜘蛛侠》三部曲。不过，他曾担任2024年剧集《星球大战：骨干小队》的联合主创，因此这次执导《星球大战》电影将是他重返这个科幻系列。

paragraphs.en: The yet-to-be-named new films, which are said to be the next chapter in the Skywalker Saga, are being written by Star Wars: Rebels and Mr. and Mrs. Smith veteran Simon Kinberg. Story details remain mostly shrouded in mystery, though it's said that Daisy Ridley's sequel trilogy Jedi, Rey Skywalker, will play a role in the story.
paragraphs.cn: 这套尚未定名的新电影据称将延续天行者传奇，由曾参与《星球大战：义军崛起》和《史密斯夫妇》的Simon Kinberg编剧。故事细节大多仍未公开，不过据称，黛西·雷德利在后传三部曲中饰演的绝地武士蕾伊·天行者将在故事中登场。

paragraphs.en: Watts has only been picked to direct the first movie of the new trilogy so far. When this next chapter will begin is also unclear, with The Hollywood Reporter sources noting that Disney has not officially given the new project the official green light as work on its foundation continues.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，Watts只被选中执导新三部曲的首部电影。这个新篇章何时启动也尚不明确。好莱坞报道者的消息人士指出，项目仍在筹备基础工作，迪士尼尚未正式批准。

paragraphs.en: Although still early in development, the site stated that it is further along than most other Star Wars projects. The only one ahead of it for now is Shawn Levy and Ryan Gosling's Star Wars: Starfighter , which has a May 28, 2027, release date.
paragraphs.cn: 好莱坞报道者表示，虽然项目仍处于早期开发阶段，但进度已领先于大多数其他《星球大战》项目。目前唯一进度更靠前的是Shawn Levy与瑞恩·高斯林的《Star Wars: Starfighter》，该片定于2027年5月28日上映。

paragraphs.en: Watts broke onto the blockbuster scene with the MCU's Spider-Man: Homecoming in 2017 and returned to make more superhero movies with follow-ups Far from Home and No Way Home in 2019 and 2021, respectively. He then handed over work on future Holland films to Destin Daniel Cretton, with his last feature, Wolfs, premiering in 2024.
paragraphs.cn: Watts凭借2017年的漫威电影宇宙作品《蜘蛛侠：英雄归来》进入商业大片领域，随后继续执导超级英雄电影，分别于2019年和2021年推出续作《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》和《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》。此后，他将赫兰德后续电影的执导工作交给了Destin Daniel Cretton。他最近的一部长片《双狼》于2024年首映。

paragraphs.en: Talk to most Star Wars fans and they'll tell you the same thing: The franchise is not in the best shape at the moment, especially when it comes to its movies. The Skywalker Saga concluded a massive nine-film arc with its sequel trilogy ender, Episode 9 – The Rise of Skywalker, in 2019, but the project capped the story with more of a whimper than a bang.
paragraphs.cn: 与大多数《星球大战》粉丝聊聊，他们都会告诉你同一件事：这个系列目前的状况不太好，电影尤其如此。2019年，后传三部曲的终章《星球大战9：天行者崛起》为天行者传奇横跨九部电影的宏大故事画上了句号，但这部电影的收尾更像是黯然落幕，而非轰轰烈烈的终结。

paragraphs.en: Although the Ridley-led films each came with their own controversial moments, The Rise of Skywalker emerged with disappointing critical reception (IGN gave it a 7/10 ) rivaled only by 1999's Episode 1 – The Phantom Menace . Disney pumped the breaks when it came to theatrical releases for a galaxy far, far away after that, with this year's The Mandalorian and Grogu bringing an end to a seven-year drought without new Star Wars movies. Even that project found its own trials to overcome, with so-so critical reception (IGN's review delivered a 5/10 ) and underwhelming box office returns leading Disney to deem it a disappointment in theaters .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然雷德利主演的几部电影各有引发争议的片段，但《星球大战9：天行者崛起》的影评反响令人失望（IGN给出了7分，满分10分），只有1999年的《星球大战1：幽灵的威胁》与之相当。此后，迪士尼放缓了这个遥远银河系的电影上映步伐，直到今年的《曼达洛人与古古》，才结束了长达七年没有《星球大战》新电影上映的空窗期。即便如此，这部电影也面临自己的难关：影评反响平平（IGN评测给出了5分，满分10分），票房表现也不尽如人意，迪士尼因此认为其院线表现令人失望。
